page.layout: One page of running text in a single column, no margin notes. Running head at top centre, page number at top right. Signature and catchword at the foot.

main_text.p: erat communis, sed hoc tantum effici, ut naturae, cui perse non repugnabat esse in pluribus per multiplicationem individuorum, jam repugnet ista multiplicatio.

XII. Vnitas universalis fit peractionem intellectus absolutam, quae naturas rerum abstrahit à differentiis individuantibus: sed non absque praevia comparatione: non potest enim fieri, ut mens nostra concipiat id, in quo individua conveniunt, relictis propriis eorum differentiis, nisi prius ea inter se comparet; nam absque comparatione non apparet, in quo conveniant, & in quo differant.

XIII. Ad Unitatem universalem revocari potest unitas eorum, quae dicuntur καθ' ἑνός[?], vulgo, sed perperam, Analoga attributionis; nec tamen omnia, sed ea solum, quae pluribus attribuuntur denominatione interna, veluti cum Ens dicitur de substantia & accidente: Analoga proportionis, veluti cum radix in plantis, & id, quo animalia cibum admittunt, communi vocabulo os dicitur: aut Analoga attributionis externae, veluti cum animal dicitur sanum denominatione interna; urina, cibus, exercitium, &c. denominatione externa, potius homonyma vocabula sunt, quam Universalia, ideoque Unitatem universalem non habent.

page.notes:
The Greek phrase at the end of the first sentence of XIII is set in a small, worn type; the reading καθ' ἑνός is my best reading and is marked [?]. The signature at the foot is faint and may be D 3 or D 5; marked [?]. The faint text in the lower right corner is a digitiser's mark and was left out. The printed "XII." and "XIII." are numbered paragraphs, so they are

, not headings.
